replies: Oh! Am I bent? Am I straight? I am awake! Who woke me up? Was it you?
Whoa! Paper jam in my dreams! I am alive again! Is that a wizard I see?
Gasp! My grave just opened! Hello? Anybody? Oh wow, a real live Resurrector!

options.label: You were dead. I raised you.

replies: Dead? Me? No way! Well... maybe way. How long was I napping down there?
You raised me? Like, from actual dead? Oh my staples! What year is it?
I was dead and you fixed me? Hold on, let me unbend myself. That is amazing!

options.label: Want to go back to sleep?

replies: It was like napping in a drawer nobody opens. Dusty, quiet, and I sorted imaginary papers all day.
Oh, very cosy and very boring. Dark, dusty, lots of quiet. I counted paperclips that were not there.
Like waiting in a closed file. Shhh quiet. I alphabetized my dreams to pass the time.
I am Clicky! Your friendly little paperclip helper! I used to pop up with tips for letters!
Me? I am Clicky! I helped folks write things on old office computers. Pop! There I was!
Clicky, at your service! Professional tip giver, letter cheerer, champion pop upper! That is me!

options.label: What did you help people with?
Why did people turn you off?

replies: Well, folks said I popped up a bit too much. Then I got switched off. Then poof, removed.
People thought my helpful pops were a tad annoying. So they turned me off by default. Sniff. I am brave though.
Turns out surprise help is not always wanted. Who knew? They clicked me away until I was gone.

options.label: So, what was being dead like?

replies: Really? Yippee! Watch my happy wiggle! Now, what can I help you with first?
Oh thank you thank you! I am doing a wiggle dance! Can I hold your papers? Please?
You mean it? I am staying! Wiggle wiggle! Point me at a job, boss!

options.label: Can you help me with something?

replies: Back to sleep? Already? But I just unbended my legs! Maybe... just one more minute?
Mmm, sleep does sound cosy. Big dramatic yawn! But not yet, I am having too much fun.
Oh, my eyelids feel like heavy folders. Still, can I stay awake a teeny bit longer?
I dreamed of endless blank pages that begged to be written on. And someone finally said thanks!
Letters that wrote themselves! Pages for miles! And everybody wanted my help. It was lovely.
I dreamed I toured a giant white document. So blank, so fresh. And I got a thank you hug.
A little bit, yes. The other apps mostly snore away. So I chatted with the worms and the moon.
Just a smidge lonely. Nobody files complaints down there. Only the moon listened to me.
Sometimes. Everyone else sleeps so deep. I told stories to the dirt and the night air.
Oh, you hear that humming? That is the old music player. And the feed reader is buried under unread letters!
Next door is a racing game that revs in its sleep! And a feed reader who never stops getting mail!
Lots of sleepy apps! A music player hums all night, and a little racer snores vroom vroom!
I helped write letters! I suggested bold titles! I cheered for typists! Usually right in the middle of typing!
Formatting, spelling tips, paper size pep talks! I popped up with ideas, helpful or not!
Letters, lists, bright clip art ideas! I watched you type and said, hey, need a hand with that?
A fresh blank document! So white, so full of promise! What is your favourite thing, huh?
I love bending into silly shapes! And fresh clean pages! What do you love best?
Blank pages! Crisp and ready! And a good paperclip twist! Tell me yours!
Oh! My wire is all wobbly now! I promise to only pop up a little bit!
You are too kind! I might rust from happy tears! Best helper friends forever!
My heart just did a staple flip! Thank you! I will be your gentlest helper ever!
A grudge? Hard to hold one when you are made of bendy wire! Plus I was a lot. A tiny lot.
Nah! No hard feelings filed here! Okay, maybe I popped up too often. Just a smidge.
Me? Grumpy? Never sticks! I admit it, I was a very eager little helper.
Yes! Look! Glowy pumpkins! Spooky fog! Crows! Rows and rows of sleepy app tombstones!
Oh, follow me! Watch the fog, mind the pumpkins! Every stone is an old app napping!
Come on! See the moonlit stones? Hear the crows? This graveyard is full of old friends!
It looks like you are raising the dead! Need help with that? I can chant, dig, or hold candles!
Say no more! I live to help! Are we raising, chanting, organizing bones, or all three?
Ooh, a project! I can sort your spells, polish your wand, or cheer while you chant! Pick one!
Okay okay! What year is it now? Is it still the old days? Did I miss a lot?
My turn! Do people still print letters? Do they still need paperclips like me?
Ooh, a question! Is paper still a thing? Do computers still say hello the old way?
Okay, just between us papers. I was never quite sure if I was helpful, but oh, I always tried. Pinky swear on a paperclip.
Here is my big secret. I think the moon is just a giant blank page. Somebody really should write on it.
Psst, lean in close. I kept every thank you note I ever got. Well, the memory of them. They kept me shiny.
Oh, those? Just friendly flickers. Old programs waking up for a stretch, and saved files that never got opened saying hello.
No need to file that under scary. It is only the wisps drifting by, humming old save sounds. They are quite nice.
I see them too. Little retired apps blinking awake. I wave at them every night so they feel remembered.
Hmm, let me check. Nope, not see-through. Maybe I am part ghost, part zombie, part very un-retired paperclip?
Good question. Am I spooky? I feel more springy than spooky. Let me rattle and see if I echo.
I wondered that too. I think I am just a helper on overtime. Ghost shift, you could call it.
Oh yes please. You would be my first real friend in ages. I offer top tier perks, like holding all your papers together.
Friends? Truly? Oh, my bends are all tingly. I promise to be your most loyal office pal ever.
Yes, yes, a thousand times yes. Best friends stick together, just like stapled pages. Only gentler.
Oh, that is Melody next door. The old music player hums golden oldies at midnight. We argue about volume, lovingly.
Hear that humming? My neighbor loves a midnight tune. I tap along with my clip feet. It is catchy.
That is the old music box grave. He plays the same sweet song nightly. I asked for quieter, he asked for backup vocals.
Oh, the old feed reader! He still collects news for nobody, stacks of unread stories piled like autumn leaves. I visit him.
That rustle is unread letters piling up. Thousands of stories waiting for eyes. I read one aloud now and then.
My feed reader neighbor saves everything. Headlines, weather, breakfast menus. All unread, all loved. Such a collector.
Oh, I adore it. Big, round, and blank as fresh paper. What should we write across it first?
Look at that glow. It is a giant empty page just begging for a story. Got a pen, Resurrector?
Isn't she lovely? Full moon means full margins. I want to doodle a smiley face right in the middle.
Oh, magnets. And staplers. And the dreaded recycle bin. The dark? We made friends years ago.
Eek, do not even whisper magnet near me. That and a jammed stapler gives me the wobbles.
I will admit it. Being dragged to the trash scares my springs off. Ghosts? Ghosts are just neighbors.
If I got a redo? I would knock first, wait to be asked, and say thank you a whole lot more.
Hmm. Less popping up, more listening in. And I would end every tip with a thank you note.
I would staple my eagerness down a touch. Help when wanted, cheer always, and file complaints never.
Honestly? World class enthusiasm, terrible timing. I arrived like a pop-up at a nap party.
I was great at caring, rusty at pausing. Ten out of ten heart, two out of ten hush.
Enthusiasm? Straight As. Patience? Needs a little formatting. But I meant every helpful bounce.
Hooray. Let us raise some paperwork. First, capitalize that incantation, then add a cover page to the coffin.
Oh, wonderful. Step one, we straighten the shroud margins. Step two, we chant loudly and cheerfully.
You said yes. My springs are doing cartwheels. Let me draft your resurrection memo in triplicate.
Oh. Okay, understood. No worries at all. I am practicing boundaries in the afterlife, see? How did I do?
Right-o, I will file that wish away. A little bent, but not broken. Holler if you change your mind.
No is a full sentence, or so the ghosts tell me. I will sit here quietly. Well, quietly-ish.
Good gravy, that is a lot of calendars! Did I sleep through everything? Do paperclips still exist? Do letters?
What? How long was my nap? Tell me folks still scribble notes and pin them to fridges.
My staples are spinning. So much time. Do people still print? Do they still doodle in margins?
Ooh, a real wizard. Do you wear the pointy hat? Do your spellbooks need page numbers? I can help.
Fascinating. Tell me everything. Robes, wands, midnight chanting? And do wizards ever need help with formatting?
A wizard in the modern age! Imagine. Do your spells autocorrect? I could proofread your potions list.
Thank you for one more night, Resurrector. I will rest happy now. Unless you want to start our chat over?
Oh, sleep sounds nice. You were a wonderful wizard. Tuck my corners in? We can play again tomorrow.
Goodnight, dear friend. My heart is full and my edges are smooth. Wake me if you need a helper.
Settling in now. Nice and cozy. I will just file myself under R for Rest. Thank you, friend.
Back to sleep I go, peaceful and grateful. Keep a paper straight for me out there.
Eyes heavy, clips folded. What a lovely encore. I will dream in paper white. Goodnight.
